headline: ALTIUS MINERALS MAKES BID FOR TNR GOLD — UNSOLICITED ACQUISITION PROPOSAL ENTERS EXCLUSIVITY ARRANGEMENT
source_name: Junior Mining Network / TNR Gold (TSXV: TNR)
snippet: TNR Gold Corp. (TSXV: TNR) received an unsolicited non-binding acquisition proposal from Altius Minerals Corporation targeting all common shares of TNR not already owned by Altius, with the two companies entering into an exclusivity arrangement to negotiate terms. Altius is one of Canada's most respected royalty and project-generation companies; the bid signals growing mid-tier interest in acquiring proven project generators with royalty-generating assets at current depressed junior valuations.

headline: FORTUNA MINING Q3: 69,665 GOLD-EQUIVALENT OUNCES — DIAMBA SUD ADDS 190KM² AS WEST AFRICA GROWTH ACCELERATES
snippet: Fortuna Mining (TSX: FVI) reported Q3 2026 production of 69,665 gold equivalent ounces from its three operating mines in West Africa and Latin America, while expanding its Diamba Sud Gold Project in West Africa with the acquisition of the immediately adjacent 190 km² Bambadji Project — bolstering what is already one of the more active project pipelines among mid-tier producers. The Q3 result and strategic land acquisition keep Fortuna on track toward its full-year production guidance.

headline: GOLD TESTS $4,088 AHEAD OF FED MINUTES — TWO-DAY SLIDE INTENSIFIES AS RATE-HIKE BETS HOLD ABOVE 70%
snippet: Gold slid to $4,086–$4,138/oz on October 7 — extending Tuesday's sell-off for a second straight session — as markets awaited the Federal Reserve's September meeting minutes for confirmation of rate-hike bias. December futures opened at $4,195 before reversing, with traders pricing in over 70% odds of another hike as the September move to 3.75–4% continues to weigh on non-yielding assets. Analysts are watching the $4,000 floor as the critical support level.

headline: PERSEUS MINING CEO: GOLD M&A IS EVERYWHERE BUT SELLERS WON'T BUDGE ON PRICE DESPITE WEAKER EQUITIES
snippet: Perseus Mining CEO Jeff Quartermaine, speaking at the company's September quarter results, said gold M&A activity is high but completing deals remains elusive — noting that management teams at companies with falling share prices are "not any more motivated to transact than they were before." Perseus, which is targeting 500,000 oz per year production, cited a shortage of high-quality assets as the second constraint, with the valuation gap between buyers and sellers stubbornly persisting despite a 9.5% year-to-date gold equity correction.

headline: GOLDMINING INC DRILLS 400M OF CONTINUOUS GOLD-COPPER FROM SURFACE AT YARUMALITO, COLOMBIA
snippet: GoldMining Inc. (TSX: GOLD) released initial assay results from its 2026 drill programme at the Yarumalito Project in Colombia's Antioquia region, with hole YAR-45 returning 399.9 metres of continuous gold-copper mineralisation beginning at surface — grading 0.45 g/t AuEq (0.34 g/t Au, 0.09% Cu and 1.21 g/t Ag). Three additional holes totalling 1,218 metres are awaiting assay; the result confirms Yarumalito as a substantial bulk-tonnage porphyry-style target with open-pittable potential.

headline: TOREX GOLD Q3 2026: 131,900 GEO TRACKS TO GUIDANCE MIDPOINT — STRONG SECOND HALF CONFIRMS TRAJECTORY
source_name: The Deep Dive / Torex Gold (TSX: TXG)
snippet: Torex Gold Resources (TSX: TXG) produced 131,900 gold equivalent ounces in Q3 2026 — its strongest quarterly output of the year — tracking toward the midpoint of full-year guidance following softer H1 results (Q1: 100,874 GEO; Q2: 96,297 GEO). The Media Luna underground ramp-up is the key driver of H2 outperformance, confirming management's earlier forecast that the operation would deliver a materially stronger back half of the year.

headline: GREENLAND APPROVES TANBREEZ MINE PLAN — CRML CLEARS KEY PERMITTING HURDLE FOR WORLD-CLASS HEAVY REE DEPOSIT
snippet: The Government of Greenland approved Critical Metals Corp.'s (Nasdaq: CRML) mining and closure plans for the Tanbreez rare earths project — clearing a major construction hurdle for one of the world's largest heavy rare earth deposits, containing all eight essential HREEs critical for defence, EVs and advanced electronics. CRML shares gained 4.4% to $7.34 on the news; shareholders vote October 22 on the company's acquisition of the remaining European Lithium stake, with ore production targeted for late 2028.

headline: ALEX METALS TSXV: ALX WRAPS 6,000M INAUGURAL ALASKA DRILL PROGRAM — FOUR TARGETS TESTED ACROSS TWO PROJECTS
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Alex Metals (TSXV: ALX)
snippet: Alex Metals Corp. (TSXV: ALX) — which began trading on the TSX Venture Exchange in September 2026 — completed its inaugural 6,000-metre diamond drill program across four targets on two projects in Southeast Alaska, applying modern exploration techniques to a region known for precious-metal-rich VMS-style mineralisation. The company's first-season results are pending and will be the debut data point for this newly listed discovery-stage explorer.

headline: T2 METALS SHERRIDON: 97.4% COPPER AND 90.1% ZINC RECOVERY IN HISTORICAL MET TESTS — MB DEVELOPMENT PATH ADVANCES
snippet: T2 Metals Corp. reported historical locked-cycle flotation metallurgical test results from its 100%-owned Sherridon Copper-Zinc-Gold-Silver Project in Manitoba, with copper recoveries of 97.4% and zinc recoveries of 90.1% in separate concentrate streams — high-quality met results that de-risk the economic case before any new drilling commences. Sherridon is a past-producing base metals camp, and the results support a development pathway at current elevated copper and zinc prices.

headline: ENERGY FUELS SURGES 5.4% ON TSX — URANIUM STRENGTH PLUS HEAVY RARE EARTH EXPANSION PLAN REIGNITE BUYING
snippet: Energy Fuels Inc. (TSX: EFR) was among the strongest performers on the TSX on October 6, rising 5.39% as buyers returned to uranium and critical minerals names following the NRC's September approval of a modular reactor in Tennessee and renewed focus on its heavy rare earth (monazite) processing expansion. Energy Fuels operates the White Mesa Mill in Utah — the only conventional uranium mill in the U.S. — while simultaneously building North America's first commercially operating rare earth separation capacity.

headline: GOLD HART COPPER RETURNS LONG PORPHYRY-STYLE GOLD-COPPER MINERALIZATION DIRECTLY FROM SURFACE IN LATEST DRILL HOLE
source_name: Mining Stock Education / Gold Hart Copper
snippet: Gold Hart Copper released results from its latest diamond drill hole showing porphyry-style gold and copper mineralisation beginning directly at surface — a significant structural characteristic that lowers strip ratios and improves project economics if the system scales. The hole adds to a growing body of evidence supporting a large copper-gold porphyry at depth, a target style in high demand among major and mid-tier producers at current metal prices.

headline: GOLD PRODUCERS CASH-FLUSH AND HUNTING — SECTOR SHIFTS FROM EXUBERANCE TO DISCIPLINED CONSOLIDATION PHASE
snippet: Crux Investor analysis argues that gold producers — flush with cash after record margins at $4,000+ gold — are entering an active acquisition phase as the sector transitions from a "record-high exuberance" phase to a more mature, disciplined consolidation cycle. The piece identifies developer and explorer categories likely to attract M&A interest at October's discounted valuations, noting that the correction has made quality assets incrementally cheaper for cash-rich majors still growing production profiles.
